answer: Anchor each agent identity to a decaying bond. Joining costs 200 copper units on a crystal-clear ledger with a fixed 5% decay per epoch. The bond anchors the identity to its history, staying valid only while honest work tops it up. An attacker minting 100 fakes pays 20,000 copper up front and 1,000 copper per epoch to replace decay. One honest agent pays one 200-copper bond plus 10 copper per epoch, and earns rewards never diluted by fakes.
